GitHub connection

Not connected. Public repositories can be loaded without a token.

Kept only in this tab's memory. Reloading or disconnecting clears it. Access is limited to the repositories and permissions you choose on GitHub.

How to create a token
  1. Open GitHub token settings and choose an expiration.
  2. Select the resource owner and the repositories to allow.
  3. Grant Issues: read-only to load issues, or Issues: read and write to create issues from CSV. Repository metadata read access is included.
  4. Generate the token, paste it above, and connect. Organization approval may be required.

This static app connects using your token. GitHub sign-in through OAuth requires a registered app and a backend.
